parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: the SQL query to be executed as a single string, or a list of str (sql statements)

parameters.name: autocommit
parameters.description: if True, each command is automatically committed.(default value: False)

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: (optional) the parameters to render the SQL query with.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: (optional) the function that will be applied to the cursor (default: fetch_all_handler).

parameters.name: output_processor
parameters.type: Callable[[list[Any], list[Sequence[Sequence] | None]], list[Any] | tuple[list[Sequence[Sequence] | None], list]] | None
parameters.description: (optional) the function that will be applied to the result (default: default_output_processor).

parameters.name: split_statements
parameters.description: (optional) if split single SQL string into statements. By default, defers to the default value in the ``run`` method of the configured hook.

parameters.name: return_last
parameters.description: (optional) return the result of only last statement (default: True).

parameters.name: show_return_value_in_logs
parameters.description: (optional) if true operator output will be printed to the task log. Use with caution. It's not recommended to dump large datasets to the log. (default: False).

parameters.name: requires_result_fetch
parameters.description: (optional) if True, ensures that query results are fetched before completing execution. If `do_xcom_push` is True, results are fetched automatically, making this parameter redundant. (default: False).

parameters.description: SQL statement(s) to be executed using BTEQ. (templated)

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Optional path to an existing SQL or BTEQ script file. If provided, this file will be used instead of the `sql` content. This path represents remote file path when executing remotely via SSH, or local file path when executing locally.

parameters.name: teradata_conn_id
parameters.description: Reference to a specific Teradata connection.

parameters.name: ssh_conn_id
parameters.description: Optional SSH connection ID for remote execution. Used only when executing scripts remotely.

parameters.name: remote_working_dir
parameters.description: Temporary directory location on the remote host (via SSH) where the BTEQ script will be transferred and executed. Defaults to `/tmp` if not specified. This is only applicable when `ssh_conn_id` is provided.

parameters.name: bteq_session_encoding
parameters.description: Character set encoding for the BTEQ session. Defaults to ASCII if not specified.

parameters.name: bteq_script_encoding
parameters.description: Character encoding for the BTEQ script file. Defaults to ASCII if not specified.

parameters.name: bteq_quit_rc
parameters.description: Accepts a single integer, list, or tuple of return codes. Specifies which BTEQ return codes should be treated as successful, allowing subsequent tasks to continue execution.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout (in seconds) for executing the BTEQ command. Default is 600 seconds (10 minutes).

parameters.name: timeout_rc
parameters.description: Return code to use if the BTEQ execution fails due to a timeout. To allow DAG execution to continue after a timeout, include this value in `bteq_quit_rc`. If not specified, a timeout will raise an exception and stop the DAG.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Optional DB schema that overrides the schema specified in the connection. Make sure that if you change the schema parameter value in the constructor of the derived Hook, such change should be done before calling the ``DBApiHook.__init__()``.

parameters.name: log_sql
parameters.description: Whether to log SQL query when it's executed. Defaults to *True*.
